paragraphs: Baron Weather sells weather data, forecasting and alerting tools to businesses, government agencies and communities. Its catalog holds hundreds of datasets, with information down to the street level. The company argues that free or incomplete sources leave organizations either over-prepared and wasteful or under-prepared and at risk.

Baron blends data from many sources into insights using analytical processes, machine learning, and AI. Many of its products carry built-in alerting and recommended actions to guide a decision. The company also builds weather radar hardware it describes as engineered for durability and sustainability. Its forecast modeling covers atmospheric, hydrological, marine, air quality, and road surface coupled models. Content is prepackaged so it can be shared quickly and understood without expertise.

The company traces its mission to 1989, when an F4 tornado devastated parts of Huntsville, Alabama. Its customer base spans government agencies, emergency managers, small startups, and Fortune 500 companies. Baron lists ISO 9001 quality management among the credentials behind its processes. ISO 14001 environmental management is listed as well.

quote.text: Our mission is to help you make informed weather decisions with confidence.
